tasks.title: Planner v2: Structured PlannerOutput + ReflectionPlannerAdapter
tasks.description: Enable the Unified Agent Runtime Loop to make structured decisions by integrating the existing planning/ module through a thin adapter layer with proper PlannerOutput enum and reflection parsing.
tasks.details: This is the next-level planner integration. It introduces PlannerOutput as the canonical decision type and a ReflectionPlannerAdapter that parses reflection text into structured actions (ToolCall, LLMCall, FinalAnswer). Must not modify planning/planner.rs or planning/reflection.rs.

subtasks.title: Add Planner trait with decide(&AgentState) -> PlannerOutput
Add PlannerOutput enum (LLMCall, ToolCall, FinalAnswer, Error)
Implement ReflectionPlannerAdapter with reflection parsing logic
Add unit tests for PlannerOutput + adapter parsing and integration test

tasks.testStrategy: Unit tests for trait and parsing, integration test running full RuntimeLoop with ReflectionPlannerAdapter, verify no changes to existing planning/ module.
